statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets once, r_T count those containing actual triangle T, d_T=6-r_T and D=sum_T d_T=6(231-R). Whenever D>0, every d_T=m>0 satisfies D>6m and therefore D>=6m+6. Equivalently d_T<=230-R for every T whenever R<231. In particular R=229 forces exactly twelve deficiency-one triangles and zero deficiency on every other triangle.
